setup_audio_bridge_linux: create an AudioBridge instance and call setup to load PulseAudio null-sink and virtual-source modules on Linux
setup_audio_bridge_darwin: create an AudioBridge instance and call setup to detect BlackHole audio device on macOS via system_profiler
teardown_audio_bridge: call teardown on an AudioBridge to unload PulseAudio modules in reverse order on Linux
access_audio_bridge_properties: access device_name and write_target properties on a setup AudioBridge to get virtual audio device identifiers
generate_chrome_fake_audio_flags: call chrome_fake_audio_flags with a platform info dict to get Chrome CLI flags for fake audio input
